name: clinc150-described
question: Which intent does this user utterance express?
source: CLINC150 (Larson et al., EMNLP 2019), CC BY-SA 3.0, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clinc/oos-eval/master/data/data_full.json
notes: Identical to clinc150-inscope except that the 16 intents involved in the dominant one-way confusions carry a written description instead of just their humanised label name. Controlled manipulation: the option list, the question and the rows are unchanged, so any difference is attributable to the descriptions. Descriptions were written from the dataset's own rows for each intent and state only the distinction the pair turns on.

criteria.reminder: Read back or list reminders that already exist.
criteria.reminder_update: Create a new reminder, or modify an existing one.
criteria.user_name: Report what the user's name currently is.
criteria.change_user_name: Set or change the name the assistant uses for the user.
criteria.insurance: Questions about the user's existing insurance policy or coverage.
criteria.insurance_change: Make a change to the user's insurance policy.
criteria.credit_score: Report the user's current credit score.
criteria.improve_credit_score: How to raise, repair or protect a credit score.
criteria.last_maintenance: When vehicle maintenance was previously carried out.
criteria.oil_change_when: When the vehicle's next oil change is due.
criteria.accept_reservations: Whether a venue takes reservations at all.
criteria.restaurant_reservation: Book a specific table at a venue.
criteria.todo_list: Read back or list to-do items that already exist.
criteria.todo_list_update: Add to or modify the to-do list.
criteria.calendar: Read back or list calendar entries that already exist.
criteria.calendar_update: Add to or modify the calendar.
